newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down after Pakistan buy.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down after Pakistan buy.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower on Monday, with market dealers saying consumer interest was still weak while official trade sources reported a substantial sale of SMR 20 to Pakistan.

At the close, July RSS1 buyer was quoted by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board at 282.50 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.13) a kg, down 1.50 cents from Friday. July SMR20 buyer was quoted a cent lower at 262.
An official trade source said 1,500 tonnes of SMR20 for July shipment was traded to Karachi 258 cents a kg. But market dealers could not confirm this.
